Yo, so you know right now when we go into our Zikr task lists, and if we tap on a list item, it goes to an edit task page. I'm just not a fan of that view. I think it would make more sense to show the last page when making a new task. But that last page needs to be edited a little bit. So then that last page acts as a confirmation page showing all the different parameters that they've set. And if they click on any of the parameters, they can go back to that page or that step, fix it. And then when they press next, it takes them back to the confirmation page.
